disabled.title: Evaluation is off
disabled.description: Observability is disabled for this deployment, so datasets cannot be built from runs.

empty.title: No dataset versions yet
empty.description: Save a reviewed case from a run, or add a reviewed synthetic example, to create the first frozen version.

forbidden.title: You cannot manage this dataset
forbidden.description: Datasets follow the Bot's management rights. Reuse across Bots needs an explicit authorized copy.

basic.title: Metrics-only source
basic.description: The source run recorded metrics only. It cannot become a text sample; supply a reviewed synthetic or redacted example instead.

omitted.title: Content omitted
omitted.description: This field could not be handled safely, so only metrics are shown. Omitted is not the same as empty.

truncated.title: Content truncated
truncated.description: This value exceeds the recorded size limit and was cut. A frozen version keeps the truncated value as saved.

syncing.title: Version still syncing
syncing.description: The version was accepted locally but is not confirmed upstream yet. Syncing is not success.

unavailable.title: Upstream unavailable
unavailable.description: The observability store did not answer, so this version cannot be read right now. Nothing was deleted.
